assessment_summary.cou_name: Estimate total pressure drop and branch flow distribution through the purge Y at 20–60 CFM for fan sizing and control margin

evidence_keywords: Mesh study: ΔP across the Y at 30 CFM changed +3.9% (2.1M→4.7M) and +1.8% (4.7M→10.3M).
Extrapolated asymptote suggests fine-grid remaining discretization effect ≈2–3%.
Three levels: 2.1M / 4.7M / 10.3M cells.
Convergence indicators: L2 residuals <1e-5 for continuity and momentum
branch mass balance <0.2%
pressure-drop monitor flat over last 1,000 iterations
Incompressible assumption (M < 0.12 throughout); constant properties at 295 K
Turbulence: SST k–ω with near-wall integration; cross-check with SA (baseline).
Wall treatment: Switching to scalable wall functions
Only steady solutions were pursued; no URANS/LES
Inlet set by prescribed volumetric flow (20, 30, 45, 60 CFM cases).
Screen implemented as internal surface with K1 = 1.7e7 1/m², K2 = 3.2e3 1/m.
coefficients from vendor curve fit at Re = 3–6×10³.
Porous jump coefficients: ±15% perturbation in K-values
Two points available on the lab mockup
pressure taps at stations P1 (upstream) and P2 (downstream of Y)
thermal mass flowmeter on the inlet leg
20 CFM: test ΔP = 70 Pa (±3 Pa).
30 CFM: test ΔP = 128 Pa (±5 Pa).
